name: Insulated combination pliers
description: A practical combination plier for gripping, bending and cutting wire during everyday installation work. Dual-material handles provide a comfortable grip. Only use tools with a verified rating appropriate to the job; isolate the circuit before working.
specification: 200 mm · Chrome vanadium steel · Dual-material grip

name: 1.5 mm² copper house wire
description: Flexible copper conductor with black PVC insulation for indoor wiring projects. Supplied as a 90 m coil. Confirm conductor sizing and installation suitability against the project's electrical requirements.
specification: 1.5 mm² · 90 m coil · Black · Copper conductor

name: 32 A single-pole MCB
description: A compact miniature circuit breaker for a compatible distribution board. The easy-to-read toggle makes the switching position visible. Select the correct breaking capacity, trip curve and rating for the installation.
specification: 32 A · Single pole · C curve · DIN rail mounting

name: Modular wall switch & plate
description: A clean white modular switch with matching wall plate for interior fit-outs. A simple profile that works across residential and commercial spaces. Check box dimensions before ordering.

name: 25 mm PVC conduit elbows
description: Keep cable routes tidy around corners with these white PVC conduit elbows. Sold as a pack of three for use with matching 25 mm conduit.
specification: 25 mm · 90° elbow · White PVC · Pack of 3

name: 2.5 mm² earth wire
description: Green and yellow insulated copper wire for identification of protective earth connections. Supplied as a compact 20 m coil. Verify the required protective conductor size for the installation.

name: Weatherproof junction box
description: A compact black enclosure with cable entry glands and a screw-fastened lid. Keeps connections organized in a suitable installation location. Use the specified seals and installation method for the enclosure's actual rating.

name: Nylon cable ties
description: A useful workshop staple for bundling and organizing cables. These black nylon ties are supplied in a pack of 100. Avoid over-tightening around cable insulation.

name: General handling gloves
description: Work gloves for handling materials, packing and general site tasks. These are general handling gloves and are not electrically insulating gloves. Do not use them for live electrical work.
specification: Size L · Reinforced palm · General handling only

name: Brass cable glands
description: Brass glands for securing suitable cables at enclosure entries. Select the gland size to match the cable's outside diameter and the enclosure opening.
specification: M20 · Brass · Seal included · Pack of 3

name: Copper ring cable lugs
description: Copper ring terminals for appropriately sized conductor connections. Use a compatible crimping tool and verify the conductor and stud dimensions before fitting.
specification: 6 mm² conductor · M6 stud · Pack of 10

name: PVC electrical insulation tape
description: Flexible black PVC tape for cable identification, bundling and suitable insulation finishing tasks. Keep a roll in the tool bag for everyday installation work.
specification: 19 mm × 20 m · Black PVC · Single roll
